title: I'm visiting the [Mathematical Institute, University of Oxford](https://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/) until December 2026, working with [Prof. Patrick Farrell](https://pefarrell.org/people). The visit is funded by a [DAAD research grant (Forschungsstipendien für Doktorandinnen und Doktoranden)](https://www2.daad.de/ausland/studieren/stipendium/de/70-stipendien-finden-und-bewerben/?detail=57556279).

I've been elected as a member of the [GAMM Juniors](https://www.gamm-juniors.de/), the young researchers' group of the [International Association of Applied Mathematics and Mechanics (GAMM)](https://www.gamm.org/).
